offering_description.value: Perma-Pipe sells pre-insulated piping, protective pipe coatings and leak detection systems to contractors, utilities and industrial operators. It designs and fabricates piping systems to project specifications and provides field services for installation and commissioning.

primary_products.value: Pre-insulated piping systems; secondary containment piping; pipe leak detection systems; protective pipe coatings

primary_services.value: Piping system engineering; custom pipe fabrication and coating; field installation supervision; leak detection commissioning

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mechanical and engineering contractors, district energy operators, oil and gas companies, and industrial facility owners; B2G: Municipal utilities and public facilities operators

end_markets.value: District heating and cooling; oil and gas; industrial processing; institutional and commercial facilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: Pre-insulated pipe, fittings, containment piping and leak detection equipment; project or contract: Custom piping design, fabrication and coating to project specifications; service fees: Field supervision, testing and commissioning
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns pipe, insulation and jacketing into engineered piping systems for contractors, utilities and industrial operators; service provider: Uses project specifications to provide engineering, coating and field services to contractors and facility owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, the Middle East and India

specialization.value: related lines: Pre-insulated piping, secondary containment, pipe coatings, leak detection and related field services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Project bids and sales to contractors, utilities and industrial operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Pipe fabrication and coating are subject to workplace safety and environmental rules, including OSHA requirements at U.S. facilities.

notes: The current mix of direct public-sector sales and separately billed field services is uncertain.
